name: Puddinq order list
author: wonder32

sections.description:
This plugin enhances the WooCommerce admin order list by adding a column that displays ordered products (including variation data), transport details, and customer notes at a glance—no need to open orders.

Key Features:
– View order products with variations directly in the order list.
– See transport and customer notes without clicking into orders.
– Works with packing slip plugins to print directly from the order list.
– Improves efficiency for shop owners and fulfillment teams.

Translations

  • English : English
  • Dutch: Nederlands
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Orders to see the new column.
sections.faq:
What if you do not see all columns?

On the top of the admin order screen there is a little tab ‘Screen Options’ (WordPress default). You can select columns there and set the number of orders.

Does this plugin work with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)?

Yes, this plugin is fully compatible with HPOS.

Is it compatible with other plugins?

The WooCommerce structure is not altered. Plugins depending on that should work fine.

What if I have problems?

If you deactivate the plugin all effects stop, and plugin data is removed.
